vulnerability.name: USN-5250-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5250-1 fixed a vulnerability in strongSwan. This update provides the corresponding update for Ubuntu 14.04 ESM and Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:   Zhuowei Zhang discovered that stringSwan incorrectly handled EAP  authentication. A remote attacker could use this issue to cause strongSwan  to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly bypass client and  server authentication.

statements.status_notes: strongSwan could crash or allow unintended access to network services. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
